 News | Dunedin Dunedin Tongan league fans bring world cup party to South Dunedin
 Saturday, November 7, 2026 SHARE facebook twitter whatsapp email linkedin facebook twitter whatsapp email linkedin PHOTO 
 Flags were flying and car horns tooting in South Dunedin, as fans of the Tongan rugby league team anticipated a crunch game against the Kiwis.
 Photo: Gregor Richardson 
 Helena St had a carnival atmosphere on Saturday afternoon.
 Photo: Gregor Richardson 
 Fans there were clear about their allegiances - they were for Tonga.
 The Rugby League World Cup semifinal between New Zealand and Tonga is due to start at 10.05pm.
 Photo: Gregor Richardson 
 The match is being played at McDonald Jones Stadium, Newcastle, Australia.
 Photo: Gregor Richardson
